source: [D23-lớp 04] - Nhóm 12.pdf, trang 13-14, Bảng 1.5; trang 27, 33-35 cho ND2

method.color: OpenCV HSV; h=2H; dark V<50; white S<40 V>=190; gray S<40 50<=V<190; other pixels red_orange [0,40) or [345,360), yellow [40,70), green [70,165), blue [165,255), purple_pink [255,345); mean per-frame fractions, first maximum in declared order
method.texture: OpenCV RGB2GRAY; Canny 100,200; fraction of nonzero edge pixels averaged across 16 frames
method.motion: 8 pairs; starts sample_times(duration-0.25,8,0.05); ends starts+0.25; nearest actual PTS; decode RGB short360; apply stored video crop; resize short256; OpenCV RGB2GRAY; mean absolute grayscale differences averaged over pairs
method.threshold_boundary: low: x<lower; medium: lower<=x<=upper; high: x>upper

mapping.D1: HSV supports color; 8 ND1 groups kept without merging
mapping.D2: LBP supports texture, evaluated by the separate ND1 Canny proxy
mapping.D4: CLIP supports subject/scene class; D3 layout not separately measured
mapping.D5: Flow supports motion; ND1 grayscale-difference proxy is related but not identical
